text.en:
The sum of one hundred thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary in appropriated
out of any funds in the Philippine Treasury not otherwise appropriated to enable the President of the
Philippines to effect adjustments of the personnel of the Department of Labor and to make such other changes
therein as are contemplated in Commonwealth Act Numbered Four hundred and fifty-three, especially for the
purpose of reorganizing the Immigration Division.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, September 30, 1939.
